location.section: TA 10.69–70 (Āndhra numbering; numbering varies by recension)

paraphrase: Before eating, the eater sips water saying 'you are the immortal under-layer'; then offers morsels saying 'In faith, entered into the breath, I offer the immortal; be propitious to me for my not burning; to prāṇa svāhā', and likewise to apāna, vyāna, udāna and samāna; 'may my self be in Brahman for immortality'; after eating, 'you are the immortal covering'; and 'the immortal offered into the breath in faith — O breath, be nourished by food'.
notes: Phase-B spot check: wording/locator matched against the local GRETIL/DCS e-text in sources_raw/ (not a formal Phase-C sourcing check).

checks.note: Confirmed in the Āndhra TA 10 (= Mahānārāyaṇa) anuvākas 69–70: 'śraddhāyāṃ prāṇe niviṣṭo 'mṛtaṃ juhomi | śivo mā viśāpradāhāya | prāṇāya svāhā … amṛtopastaraṇam asi …' (69) and 'śraddhāyāṃ prāṇe niviśyāmṛtaṃ hutam | prāṇam annenāpyāyasva …' (70). Numbering as the entry says (Āndhra; varies by recension).

paraphrase: Renunciation (nyāsa) is Brahman; it surpasses all the austerities listed — truth, discipline, calm, charity, sacrifice.
notes: Section numbering differs between Āndhra and Drāviḍa recensions of TA 10.
